transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad, and it feels like I can't shake this heavy feeling. It's been going on like this for about eight months now. I just feel completely down.
Have you felt this way nearly every single day for the past eight months, or have there been periods of a few weeks or more where you felt like your usual self?
Yes, it has been nearly every single day without any breaks. I haven't had any periods where I felt like my usual self again. It has just been constant for the entire eight months.
During these past eight months, have you lost interest or pleasure in almost all of the activities that you used to enjoy?
Yes, completely. I've stopped doing any of my hobbies because they just don't bring me any happiness or satisfaction anymore. Absolutely nothing seems to make me feel good or interested these days.
